title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 2.77 (versions follow prime numbers; 277 after 271): her frame coefficient (the author's note of 0.53: what counts is when you doubted the statement). What pays her (her thread, her playing on, her tastes for each book) is no longer a fixed rule: three frames, three signals of his after she speaks (he followed the theme: a word of that exchange again that carries something for her beyond chance and is not her name; he was moved: his chromatic charge above his mean; he brought something new: a word of his not in that exchange); each frame counts how often it disagreed with the other two, she trusts the one in most harmony and doubts hers when another is in more; kept in 'gustos'. Measured in a copy: disagreements (2, 1, 1): she doubted 'he followed the theme' (the rule given to her) and trusts 'something new'; tastes: 3 books, 2 paid. Stated: with few talks the frames still jump; how they settle in a long talk is not measured. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v2.77: su coeficiente de marco. Prototipo de investigación.
